browser_accept_again: Still asking after you accepted it? Then the host is not answering pages like this one: turn on Browser streaming in its web console. Safari reaches a host this way only through a Punktfunk server.
browser_accept_body: A Punktfunk host signs its own certificate, so your browser will not talk to it until you say so once. Open this, accept the warning, then come back.
browser_bad_signature: The host's signature over its certificate hash does not verify
browser_bridge_unopened: This page's server couldn't open a connection to the host. Try again in a minute, and if it keeps happening, check that WebSocket connections reach the server.
browser_cannot_decode: This browser can't decode video. Open this page in a current Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
browser_cert_no_key: The host certificate carries no P-256 key
browser_device_key: This browser couldn't open its device key. Allow this site to store data, then try again.
browser_legacy_identity: This host still has its older identity, which a browser can't pair with. Moving it to the new one means unpairing its other devices, restarting it and pairing them again.
browser_link_other_host: The link names a different host than the one paired here
browser_needs_https: This page isn't on an https address, so the browser won't stream from it. Open it over https.
browser_no_attestation: This host published no attestation, so a paired browser can't connect to it
browser_no_plane: This host does not offer the browser plane
browser_not_paired_host: This is not the host that was paired with
browser_pair_again_body: This host no longer knows this browser — it was unpaired there. Enter the PIN it is showing to pair again.
browser_plane_off: Browser streaming is off on this host. Turn it on in the host's web console, under Host → Settings, then restart the host.
browser_reply_unreadable: This page couldn't read what the host sent
browser_sign_in_failed: This browser couldn't sign in to the host. Try again in a moment.
browser_skew_hint: Update the host, or this page, so the two agree.
browser_skew_title: This host speaks a different version
browser_too_many: Too many requests from this address. Wait a minute, then try again.
browser_trust_advice: If you reinstalled Punktfunk on it, or reset its configuration, that is expected — remove this host and pair again. If you did not, stop here: something else is answering at that address.
browser_trust_body: Something is answering at {host}, but it can't prove it is the host this browser paired with.
browser_udp_unreachable: Couldn't reach the host on UDP {port}, its browser streaming port. Check that nothing between this device and the host blocks it.
browser_wake_failed: Couldn't wake {host} — this page's server didn't send the wake packet.
browser_wake_timeout: {host} didn't answer within a minute of waking. It may still be starting.
browser_wake_unpaired: Only a browser paired with {host} can wake it from this page.
browser_wt_refused: The browser refused the WebTransport session
browser_hosts_sub_first: Add the host you want to stream from.
browser_hosts_sub: Click a host to stream its desktop.
browser_nav_console_hint: Built for a TV and a controller
browser_announce_accept_a11y: This host's certificate must be accepted once
browser_announce_pair_a11y: Enter the PIN this host is showing
browser_announce_waiting_a11y: Waiting for approval of {name} in the host's web console
browser_announce_trust_a11y: This is not the host that was paired with
browser_announce_link_a11y: A link asks to connect to {name}
browser_lib_load_failed_desktop: {why} You can still stream the desktop.
browser_ring_menu_hint_tv: {remote} on the remote, or {pad} on a controller
browser_stats_scale_pct_hint: The overlay's size, on top of the page's own.
browser_custom_size_hint: Width × height in pixels. Applied when a field loses focus.
browser_resize_stream_hint: Renegotiates the size when the window changes mid-stream. The host rebuilds its capture to answer, which interrupts the picture.
browser_video_backend_hint: Automatic uses WebGPU where the browser has it. Once a stream has played, a change waits for the page to reload.
browser_console_mode_hint: The controller interface every Punktfunk client shares, for a TV or a controller.
browser_prefs_page_hint: These apply to every host. Stream settings take effect on the next stream.
browser_prefs_dialog_hint: Mouse, controller and statistics settings apply now; the rest take effect on the next stream.
browser_player_mouse_mode_capture_hint: A click locks the pointer for games with mouselook; {keys} releases it.
browser_prefs_reset_hint: Every setting on every tab back to its default.
browser_sound_suspended: Sound is off until you click or press a key.
browser_notice_no_hdr: This browser can't show HDR video, so the stream is in SDR.
browser_codec_fallback: This browser can't decode {from}, so the stream uses {to}.
browser_codec_fallback_pinned: This browser can't decode {from}, so the stream uses {to}, ignoring the Video codec setting
browser_exit_menu: Menu, then End stream, to leave
